checks.title: Head read, Codex pass 3
checks.question: Does it read as the sheet's head?
checks.recommended: Orchestrator's read: partly. Reconstruction gave it a real nasal bridge, cheek plane and small nose, but the muzzle still runs long, the eyes sit small in flat rings, and the retained pass-2 horns stay thin and wide-spread against the sheet.

remaining: The preserved pass-2 horns read thinner and more widely spread than the approved head close-up, especially across their upper arcs. Their geometry was explicitly retained by the pass-3 instructions.
The saved reconstruction still has broad facets and uneven small planes across the cheeks and nasal bridge at close range. Those areas are outside the allowed socket, attachment-seat, and neck edits.
The upper orbital tissue retains small angular corners, and the added lid rims are more uniform than the organic lids in the sheet.
The neck blend has faint stretched shading lines at the close camera. Its silhouette is continuous and its changes are confined to the declared neck region.
The shaved gray head cannot show the sheet's fur silhouette, amber iris, or horizontal pupil at this stage. No final art approval is claimed.
report.note: Codex pass 3 (first attempt 31.7 min blocked on the Blender wait rule, resume 25.6 min through the slot lock, 200K Codex tokens). Orchestrator assessment: a clear step up from its pass 2 and the method change worked here too, but it lands below the Claude stream pass 4 (B-rv4f): muzzle longer than the sheet, eyes small and sunken, horns thin and wiry (Codex kept its pass-2 horns as instructed), neck blend shows shading lines. Outside the head unchanged except the declared neck region (max 17.6 mm there). Kept as the Codex comparison build; the Claude head is the one at Nick's gate.
